name: Egg Curry in Coconut Milk

source.cookbook: The Complete and Authentic Thai Curry Cookbook 2
source.author: Various

method: Peel the boiled eggs, coat them with a little turmeric, and set aside.
Heat 4 tablespoons oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Fry the turmeric-coated eggs for a couple of minutes, turning until golden, then transfer them to a plate.
Heat a little oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the bay leaf and whole spices and cook for a couple of minutes, until fragrant and crackling.
Add the onion paste, ginger paste, and garlic paste. Fry for a couple of minutes, until browned.
Add the green chilies and tomato purée. Stir well and fry for another couple of minutes.
Add the coriander, red chili, and cumin powders. Stir well and fry for a couple of minutes, until the oil begins to separate at the sides.
Add about ½ cup water, stir well, and season with salt. Cover and cook for 5 minutes.
Remove the lid, pour in the coconut milk, stir well, and remove from the heat.
Add the fried eggs, sprinkle with chopped coriander, and serve hot.
